reference_frame.view: looking back down the corridor: dithered grey stone ceiling+floor+side-walls + a large central stained-glass window/portcullis (the terminal element) filling most of the lower-center

findings.claim: The lookback viewport (176x112) is NOT a clean floor-band + ceiling-band + 4-side-walls + small-terminal decomposition. It is a DENSE dithered-stone scene (idx 8 dark-grey 5393px, idx 9 light-grey 8243px, idx 0 black-seam 3947px, idx 1 white 1183px) with a LARGE central terminal element — the stained-glass window/portcullis — whose colored pixels (idx 5 yellow, 10 bright-green, 12 bright-red, 13 magenta, 14 bright-yellow; 946 px total) span x74..246 / y52..143 (nearly the full lower-center width, not a small far cap). The whole viewport is geometry+dither, so 'add a static floor/ceiling backdrop' is not viable (confirmed by maze-background-nature.json) and there is no small isolated terminal element to decode separately.

evidence.details: Decoded maze-corridor-lookback.idx.gz viewport crop. Index histogram {0:3947,1:1183,5:216,8:5393,9:8243,10:35,12:111,13:294,14:290}. Colored (window) px: 946, x[74..246] y[52..143]. findings.claim: BLOCKER. A fresh patched-core drive to lookback reaches a DIFFERENT frame than the committed maze-corridor-lookback fixture — divergent EVERYWHERE, not just in the animated window. Band-by-band, the fresh-drive compose page vs the committed fixture (RGB via COMPOSED_PALETTE): left side-wall x72..115 = 38.2%, right side-wall x205..248 = 40.2%, center/window x115..205 = 47.4%, ceiling y32..52 = 50.3%, floor y112..144 = 62.3%; full viewport = 43.43%. The dithered stone is POSITION/PHASE-dependent, so even a sub-cell or animation-phase difference scrambles the dither across the whole view. Because the committed 613923-B serialize-state will NOT unserialize on the 588156-B patched trace core (and the nightly core that CAN load it has no trace/capture), there is no way to capture the compose page (or RE the source->page transform) for the EXACT committed frame. Byte-exact (tolerance 0) reproduction of the committed fixture is therefore not attainable until this fixture/core mismatch is resolved.

findings.claim: Even with a capturable frame, porting the floor/ceiling+window FROM-ASSET requires (a) the proprietary masked-image PIXEL decoder (the in-RAM floor id=1346 / ceiling id=1740 blocks + the window element are the wroot/EGA-driver masked-run encoding, NOT a flat planar bitmap — still UNCRACKED per wmaze-texture-rasterizer.json texture-in-ram-format-proprietary-masked, confidence medium) and (b) the source->page blit transform. The static-disasm thunk 0xfb27 (the claimed floor/ceiling blit) has NO literal `call 0xfb27` site in wmaze.ovr (0 matches scanning every E8 rel16) — so that finding's blit-entry label is unconfirmed/likely wrong; the floor/ceiling fill is reached by another path. The 0xf148 edge-emit thunk has 28 call sites but its wroot target is still unresolved (the -0xBA9C delta law fails for these high thunks). So the source->page compositor for floor/ceiling/window is NOT yet RE'd, independent of the fixture blocker.

evidence.details: Capstone scan of wmaze.ovr for E8 rel16 with target 0xfb27: 0 sites. Target 0xf148: 28 sites (0x40af,0x40f5,0x42ab,...). The 0x3fcf region the prior finding labelled 'view_load_zone_and_fill' disassembles as the tail of span_append (0x3f8d) + the start of wall_emit_quad (0x406c), not a floor/ceiling loader. generalizes: The compose-page format + page->screen identity decode (decodePageIndex) is the complete renderer for ANY facing — confirmed 100%/100% for facing 2 (lookback), as previously for facing 0 (corridor). Filling the page is the only remaining work for every frame.

The wt=2 side-wall pipeline (classify->build->flush->compositor) is byte-exact at the span level for lookback's 4 spans (1839 px), and generalizes (validated across 11/12 captured frames per classify.ts).
lookback_specific: Nothing about the floor/ceiling/window is lookback-specific per se — they are per-view geometry rasterizations. But the DITHER is position/phase-sensitive, so a frame that is even slightly off geometrically diverges across the whole viewport (this is what makes the fresh-drive vs committed-fixture mismatch fatal for byte-exact).

recommendation: TWO independent blockers must clear before lookback full-viewport byte-exact is attainable: (1) FIXTURE/CORE MISMATCH (the gating one): make the committed lookback frame capturable on the trace core — either re-mint the maze fixtures (maze-corridor.state + the 4 derived frames) on the PATCHED trace core so live page-capture matches the committed pixels, OR add patched-core support for the nightly 613923-B serialize format. Without this, no source->page RE can be validated against the committed answer. (2) SOURCE->PAGE COMPOSITOR RE (the deep one): crack the proprietary masked-image pixel decoder for the floor (id 1346) / ceiling (id 1740) / window blocks and reverse the blit that places them into the compose page (the 0xf148 edge-emit + the real floor/ceiling fill path; resolve the wroot thunk targets via runtime single-step since the delta law fails). Suggest doing (1) first (cheap, unblocks validation), then (2) with live page-capture as the oracle (capture the committed frame's page, decode it 100%, then reverse source->page with the page as ground truth — from-asset, not a fixture slice).
